protocol.architecture: Unchanged V10 LocalTwoHead, architecture kind plain/structured; matched ordinary/structured budgets. MSE and task pairs share initializations and batch order per seed. Original GRU is never optimized.
protocol.loss: Original V10 group-balanced masked motion MSE + paired response MSE + residual energy; task variants additionally use V11 exact normalized paired COST EFFECT error with detached true reference labels on fully valid calls ONLY. No low-predicted-cost/ranking reward, no label-based resampling; partial support still contributes physical masked supervision.
protocol.normalization: Only the fresh V12 train histories; no V10/V12 development normalization or finetuning.
protocol.selection: Fixed final epoch; middle of three seeds ordered by fresh development group-equal all-branch ADE, then seed. No best seed/epoch/sweep. Report every seed, every architecture, all losses and controls.
protocol.gate_scope: Evaluate ordinary-task and structured-task separately. Passing is research eligibility only, never online promotion. Selected gain bounds must be strictly positive using same frozen local library/full common support. Causal-response usefulness requires improvement over zero response and own motion, not merely architecture superiority or common-motion gains. V10 gate remains failed.

decision_bootstrap.interpretation: Fresh V12 development gate, not reserved holdout; no tuning after inspection.

protocol.later_required: Independent retraining and source/trajectory audit; new-model self-generated library and sequential shadow; default-off/failure fallback; untouched holdout, original eight Levels, new-scene closed-loop, safety and latency. Whole optional module off preserves original; response-anchor zero alone does not.
